sources.snippet: Overview Qwen3.5-9B-GLM5.1-Distill-v1 is a 9-billion-parameter reasoning model created by Jackrong through supervised fine-tuning and knowledge distillation from GLM-5.1. The model builds on the Qwen3.5-9B base with training using Unsloth and LoRA, optimized to improve structured reasoning, instruction-following consistency, and latent knowledge activation.
